description: This file defines the Theme entity class used within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_theme' table in the database. It includes constants for image validation, properties for theme attributes like logos and banners, and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents a theme configuration entity with properties for images and settings, mapped to the 'ohrm_theme' database table, including constants for allowed image types and aspect ratios.
